scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../.. run build:ort && npm --prefix ../.. run build:info && VITE_MODELS_BASE=https://lolli.li vite build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../web/src/locales'))if(f.endsWith('.json'))fs.rmSync('dist/info/'+f.slice(0,-5),{recursive:true,force:true})"
